name: Telluric-Zij
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in rare flora here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
